description.ja: 『ULTRAMAN』より、早田進が装着するゾフィースーツがFigure-rise Standardに堂々参戦！
description.en: From "ULTRAMAN", the Sophie suit worn by Susumu Hayata will be participating in Figure-rise Standard!

description.ja: ■複数のボールジョイントで胸部と腹部を連結し可動させることにより、ひねり方向の可動域の大幅アップに成功。
description.en: • By connecting and moving the chest and abdomen with multiple ball joints, we have succeeded in significantly increasing the range of motion in the twisting direction.

description.ja: ■首パーツがボールジョイントになったことで、頭部の回転方向の可動域が大幅に拡大。
description.en: • The neck part is now a ball joint, which greatly expands the range of motion in the rotational direction of the head.

description.ja: ■胸、肩のほか、エフェクトパーツにも偏光パール素材を用いたクリアパーツを採用。
description.en: • In addition to the chest, shoulders, and effect parts, clear parts using polarized pearl material are used.

description.ja: ■腹部関節は「可動優先時」と「LEDユニット（別売り）内蔵時」の２パターンの選択式。
description.en: • The abdominal joint can be selected from two patterns: "when movable is prioritized " and " when the LED unit (sold separately) is built in".

description.ja: ■LEDユニット（別売り）を胸部に収め、胸と目を光らせることができる。
description.en: • An LED unit (sold separately) can be placed in the chest to make the chest and eyes shine.

accessories.ja: ハンドパーツ　握り手（左右）、表情手（左右）、武器持ち手（右）
accessories.en: Hand parts Gripping hands (left and right), expression hands (left and right), weapon holders (right)
